top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a coherent, mature achievement linking foundational GLP-1 physiology to extensive and durable medical benefit in diabetes and obesity. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker defensibly represent the foundational and mechanistic components if the citation remains limited to physiology that enabled, rather than solely developed, later therapies.
recusal_note: I have coauthored approximately twenty works with fellow member Thomas Perlmann according to the supplied profile. No profile-based connection to the proposed laureates is apparent.
